CONNECT YOUR AGENT

The bridge from diff to fix.

The Node backend reads your local Git repository and sends a structured request to your agent. Credentials stay on the server. This page documents the integration; edit .env to change it.

Connection status

Loading…

1. Configure your backend

REPO_PATH=/absolute/path/to/your/repository
AI_AGENT_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000/analyze
AI_AGENT_KEY=your-optional-token

Copy .env.example to .env, update these values, then restart with npm start. The agent endpoint must accept JSON POST requests and return JSON. An optional key is sent as a Bearer token. Provider-specific SDKs can be connected in server/agent.js.

Only click “Send diff to agent” for a repository you intend to share with that configured endpoint. The request includes the diff and summaries of your existing fix records.

2. Agent request contract

{
  "task": "Instructions for finding fixes and treating source code as data",
  "comparison": {
    "baseSha": "resolved full commit SHA",
    "headSha": "resolved full commit SHA",
    "files": ["src/users.js"],
    "diff": "diff --git ..."
  },
  "previousFixes": [
    {"errorId": "ERR-ab12cd34", "error": "...", "rootCause": "...", "fixSummary": "..."}
  ],
  "responseSchema": {"fixes": ["field descriptions"]}
}

3. Agent response contract

{
  "fixes": [{
    "error": "Inferred: null value caused list rendering to fail",
    "file": "src/users.js",
    "rootCause": "Inferred: API response may be null",
    "fixSummary": "Default to an empty array before mapping",
    "evidence": "Changed users.map(...) to (users ?? []).map(...)",
    "category": "Null handling",
    "similarMatch": []
  }]
}

Return an empty fixes array for changes without bug fixes. Required fields: error, file, rootCause, fixSummary. The file must exist in the diff. Optional matches use {"errorId":"an existing ID","score":92}. Invalid responses are rejected. All generated fixes start as unconfirmed drafts; nothing is automatically saved.

Local API endpoints

EndpointPurpose
GET /api/logsRead saved fixes
POST /api/logsCreate a fix post
PUT /api/logs/:errorIdReplace editable fields on a fix
POST /api/compareGet exact tree diff between baseSha and headSha
POST /api/analyzeCompare commits and return validated agent drafts
GET /api/configRead connection status without exposing the key
curl http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/compare \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"baseSha":"abc1234","headSha":"def5678"}'

Replace the example IDs with commits from your checkout. The comparison includes the net changes between the two commit trees, including merges. Commits must already exist locally; fetch remote commits first. Binary files may be listed without textual changes.
